briefing: NASDAQ +1.7% and S&P 500 +0.8% confirm a risk-on day, and with 3 open slots and cash above the deployment threshold, we filled all three with momentum names showing strong technical confirmation. TSLA stands out with full 5-signal confirmation including a volume surge; SMMT and RIG add cheap, diversified exposure with matching bullish RSI/MACD setups. Existing positions are held unchanged since nothing here warrants an exit on a bullish tape.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, on the theory that strength tends to continue in the short term. Today's buys were chosen because multiple technical signals — rising price trend, bullish momentum indicators, and heavier-than-usual trading volume — all pointed the same direction at once, which lowers (but doesn't eliminate) the risk of chasing a false signal.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資（Momentum Investing）是指買入已經處於上升趨勢的股票，理論基礎是短期內強勢股份往往會延續升勢。今日的買入選擇是因為多項技術指標——上升的價格趨勢、偏向好友的動能指標，以及高於平均的成交量——同時指向同一方向，這降低（但不能完全消除）追逐假訊號的風險。

market_education.summary_en: Markets rallied broadly today, with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500 as growth and tech-adjacent names led gains. The breadth of bullish MACD crossovers and volume surges across the screened list (TSLA, SNDK, SPCX, ARQT) points to broad institutional buying rather than an isolated move. No major stop-loss or profit-target triggers fired in the existing portfolio, consistent with a steady risk-on tone rather than volatility-driven swings.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍上揚，納斯達克升幅高於標普500指數，反映科技及成長股領漲。篩選名單中多隻股票（如TSLA、SNDK、SPCX、ARQT）同時出現MACD黃金交叉及成交量放大，顯示機構資金廣泛流入，而非個別股份的孤立波動。現有持倉未觸發止蝕或獲利點，顯示今日屬穩定的風險偏好（risk-on）格局，而非劇烈波動行情。
